findings.title: Browsers mark the site "Not Secure"
findings.detail: The site only works over plain http, so browsers warn visitors, which is especially off-putting on a site that links to dues payments.

findings.title: The homepage is one long block of text
findings.detail: It has a single heading ("Come and Visit"), so residents have to read everything to find what they came for.

findings.title: Common tasks are hidden or hard to find
findings.detail: Payments, documents and newsletters are only in the top menu, and architectural review and the pavilion reservation aren't in the menu at all.

findings.title: "Upcoming Events" is out of date
findings.detail: It still shows the 2024 annual meeting minutes, as a Word file download that's awkward to open on a phone.

findings.title: Photos are small and unlabeled
findings.detail: The entrance photo is only 329×226 pixels, so it looks blurry on today's screens, and none of the images have descriptions for screen readers.

fixes: A clear "common tasks" row: payments, documents & forms, home projects, contact the board
News and meeting records in one place, kept current
A secure (https) site with descriptive image labels

imageAlt.before: Current Spring Lake Farm HOA homepage: a large entrance-sign banner, a long column of text, and small photos low on the page
imageAlt.after: Redesigned Spring Lake Farm HOA homepage: a headline with a neighborhood photo, a row of four common tasks, and a news section
